_comment: NOT the primary way to set league scoring — that's the side panel's live 'Scoring settings' form (chrome.storage.local, picked up by background.js's chrome.storage.onChanged, recomputed live via recomputeWithScoringRules in liveDraftState.js). League settings differ per user's real league, so a JSON file only a developer could hand-edit isn't the right mechanism for that — this file exists only as the build-time SEED for DEFAULT_SCORING_RULES (leagueScoring.js), i.e. what a fresh install's side-panel form shows before any user customization. Edit this only if you want to change what ships as the out-of-the-box default for every user, then rerun `node scripts/build-projections.js`.
